title: Spec code sample: ToolDef fields use String instead of &'static str
description: Step 1 of moeb.run-command-tool.md provided a code sample with `.to_string()` calls on `ToolDef.name` and `ToolDef.description`, but the actual `ToolDef` struct (src/moeb/src/adapters/mod.rs) declares both as `&'static str`. This caused a compile error requiring a post-write patch during run 9ef065cf-469d-4284-ab94-bbee84e3c208.
proposed_resolution: When authoring spec code samples that construct ToolDef, use `&'static str` literals (no `.to_string()` calls). Refer to existing tool implementations (e.g. grep_files.rs) for the correct pattern.
